caseNameFull: Sonja RITTER v. Lois BRADY, Chapter 7 Trustee.

opinions.text: Motion of the Honorable Eugene Wedoff, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Professor Margaret Howard for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
